schemes.name: PM-AJAY: Grants-in-Aid (Comprehensive Livelihood Projects)
schemes.department: Dept. of Social Justice & Empowerment, MoSJE

eligibility.notes: No fixed income limit. Priority to persons/families with annual income up to Rs 2.5 lakh. SC-majority groups also eligible.

benefits: Skill development linked to livelihood projects (RPL 32-80 hrs, short-term 200-600 hrs, EDP ~80 hrs, long-term 6 months+)
Financial assistance up to Rs 50,000 or 50% of project cost, whichever is less, where the beneficiary takes a loan for livelihood assets
schemes.how_to_apply: Benefits are delivered through approved State/District projects and implementing agencies, not a direct individual application. Beneficiaries are mobilised and selected by the State/District administration or the training partner through a selection committee. Ask the District Social Welfare/SC Welfare office (suggested contact, not named in the guidelines).
schemes.helpline_note: No helpline printed in the May 2023 guidelines.
schemes.notes: Verified against Revised Guidelines (May 2023), Ch. 3. Approved period in the guidelines runs to 2025-26; confirm the current cycle on the portal.

schemes.name: DSFDC Composite Loan Scheme
schemes.department: Delhi SC/ST/OBC/Minorities & Handicapped Finance & Development Corporation

other: Owned or rented workplace for the activity
Not a defaulter under any DSFDC scheme

benefits: Need-based loan up to Rs 3 lakh (SC)
Need-based loan up to Rs 1 lakh (OBC, Minority, PwD)
Loans up to Rs 50,000: guarantor/collateral not required (discretionary); two local references needed
documents_required: Loan application form (free, from branches or website)
Caste certificate (Delhi Govt) / PwD certificate (min 40%) / affidavit for minorities
Estimate of items/machines to be bought
Workplace ownership proof or rent agreement with owner's ID
Affidavit of no loan from other institutions; personal guarantee affidavit
Rs 350 demand draft as processing fee
Two witnesses with ID; guarantor documents for larger loans
schemes.how_to_apply: Apply directly at a DSFDC branch: Rajpur Road, Mangolpuri, Nand Nagri, or HQ at Rohini.
schemes.notes: Verified against the DSFDC scheme PDF. The PDF is undated and cites an old delhi.gov.in URL, so income and loan limits may have been revised; confirm at a branch. Loan limit for ST applicants is not stated in the PDF.

schemes.name: Dilli Swarojgar Yojna (DSFDC Micro-Credit)
schemes.description: Collateral-free micro loans up to ₹5 lakh at low interest (6%) for petty shops, sewing/tailoring units, dairy, mobile repair, and artisan workshops.

other_criteria: Annual family income under ₹2,00,000
No prior default on any government loan

benefits.financial_assistance: Micro loans up to ₹5,00,000 with simple documentation
benefits.loan_subsidy: Interest charged at 6% p.a., rebate of 1% on timely repayment
benefits.details: Collateral-free up to ₹1,00,000 with personal guarantee; flexible 5-year repayment schedule.

documents_required: Delhi Voter ID / Ration Card (3+ years residency)
Rent agreement or shop ownership proof
how_to_apply: Apply online via e-District Delhi Portal or in person at DSFDC field offices
Fill enterprise details (tailoring, food stall, electrical repair, salon)
Verification by field welfare inspector
Sanction letter issued within 30 working days

schemes.name: Post-Matric Scholarship Scheme for SC Students (Delhi NCT)
schemes.department: Department for the Welfare of SC/ST/OBC, GNCTD & MoSJE
schemes.description: Full tuition fee reimbursement and monthly maintenance allowance for Scheduled Caste students pursuing post-matriculation courses, ITI, polytechnic, and university degrees in Delhi.

other_criteria: Passed Class 10th or higher
Enrolled in recognized ITI, Diploma, Polytechnic or College

benefits.financial_assistance: 100% non-refundable fees reimbursed directly to institution or student
benefits.stipend: Maintenance allowance from ₹550 to ₹1,200 per month depending on course group
benefits.toolkit_support: Book grant & study tour allowance for technical courses
benefits.details: Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) directly into Aadhaar-seeded bank account via PFMS.

documents_required: SC Caste Certificate issued by GNCTD
Fee Receipt & College Admission Verification Letter
how_to_apply: Login to e-District Delhi portal (edistrict.delhigovt.nic.in)
Select 'Post-Matric Scholarship for SC Students'
Fill academic and institution enrollment details
Upload fee receipts and certificates
Institution nodally verifies application, followed by State Welfare Dept approval

schemes.name: Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP Delhi)
schemes.department: Khadi and Village Industries Commission (KVIC) / Delhi KVI Board
schemes.description: Credit-linked subsidy programme to generate self-employment ventures. SC beneficiaries in Delhi urban and rural pockets receive up to 35% government subsidy on project cost.

other_criteria: Project cost above ₹10 Lakh in manufacturing or ₹5 Lakh in service requires min 8th pass
Only new projects are eligible

benefits.financial_assistance: Maximum project cost ₹50 Lakh for manufacturing, ₹20 Lakh for service units
benefits.stipend: Free EDP (Entrepreneurship Development Programme) training (5 to 10 days)
benefits.loan_subsidy: SC beneficiaries receive 35% margin money subsidy in rural areas, 25% in urban Delhi
benefits.details: Beneficiary contribution only 5% of project cost for SC category.

documents_required: SC Caste Certificate issued by GNCTD
Project Proposal Report with machinery cost breakups
Highest Educational Certificate (min 8th pass for large units)
how_to_apply: Apply online on kviconline.gov.in/pmegpeportal
Select Implementing Agency: Delhi Khadi & V.I. Board or KVIC Delhi
Upload DPR and caste verification documents
District Task Force Committee (DTFC) reviews and forwards to bank branch in Delhi
